update t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a a.robot_instance_id = #{robotInstanceId}, a.video_preset_id = #{videoPresetId}, a.cruise_name = #{cruiseName}, a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId}, a.device_id = #{deviceId}, a.custom_id = #{customId}, a.identify_type = #{identifyType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.identify_son_type = #{identifySonType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.cruise_type = #{cruiseType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.warn_threshold = #{warnThreshold, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.warn_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.interval_type = #{intervalType, jdbcType=INTEGER},
where a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select a.instance_id, a.station_id, a.station_name, a.robot_instance_id, a.video_preset_id, b.cruise_name as robot_instance_name, c.cruise_name as video_preset_name, d.device_mete_name, e.custom_id, f.device_id, d.mete_name, e.custom_name, f.device_name, a.identify_type, a.identify_son_type, a.cruise_type, a.warn_threshold, a.warn_level, a.interval_type, a.if_sy, a.sy_type from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = a.robot_instance_id left join t_cruise_point_instance c on c.instance_id = a.video_preset_id left join t_std_devicemete d on d.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id left join t_std_device e on e.custom_id = a.custom_id left join t_std_device f on f.device_id = a.device_id where 1 = 1 and a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

select a.instance_id, a.robot_instance_id, a.video_preset_id, b.cruise_name as robot_instance_name, c.cruise_name as video_preset_name, d.device_mete_id, e.custom_id, e.device_id, d.mete_name as device_mete_name, e.custom_name, e.device_name, a.identify_type, a.identify_son_type, d.mete_type, a.cruise_type, a.cruise_name, a.warn_threshold, a.warn_level, a.interval_type from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = a.robot_instance_id left join t_cruise_point_instance c on c.instance_id = a.video_preset_id left join t_std_devicemete d on d.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id left join t_std_device e on d.custom_id = e.custom_id and d.device_id = e.device_id where 1 = 1 and a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.robot_instance_id = #{robot_instance_id, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.video_preset_id = #{videoPresetId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.identify_type = #{identifyType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.identify_son_type = #{identifySonType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.cruise_type = #{cruiseType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and e.device_name like concat('%',#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and d.mete_name like concat('%',#{deviceMeteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.cruise_name like concat('%',#{cruiseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.warn_threshold = #{warnThreshold, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.warn_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.warn_id as warnId, a.instance_id as instanceId, a.warn_content as warnContent, a.warn_time as warnTime, d.mete_name as deviceMeteTime, e.custom_id as customId, e.device_id as deviceId, d.device_mete_id as deviceMeteId, e.custom_name as customName, e.device_name as deviceName, e.device_type as deviceType, k.dict_note as deviceTypeName, f.region_name as delayName, f.region_id as delayId, h.robot_name as robotName, a.warn_type as warnType, n.warn_level as warnLevel, j.camera_name as cameraName from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn a inner join t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance n on n.instance_id = a.instance_id left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = n.robot_instance_id left join t_cruise_point_instance c on c.instance_id = n.video_preset_id left join t_std_devicemete d on d.device_mete_id = n.device_mete_id left join t_std_device e on d.custom_id = e.custom_id and d.device_id = e.device_id left join t_std_region f on e.up_region_id = f.region_id left join t_robot_inspection g on g.inspection_id = b.cruise_id left join t_robot_info h on h.robot_id = g.robot_id left join t_camera_preset i on i.preset_id = c.cruise_id left join t_camera_info j on j.camera_id = i.camera_id left join t_dict_business k on k.dict_code = e.device_type where 1 = 1 and a.warn_id = #{warnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
union all select a.warn_id as warnId, a.instance_id as instanceId, a.warn_content as warnContent, a.warn_time as warnTime, m.device_mete_name as deviceMeteTime, m.custom_id as customId, m.device_id as deviceId, m.device_mete_id as deviceMeteId, m.custom_name as customName, m.device_name as deviceName, m.device_type as deviceType, m.device_type_name as deviceTypeName, m.region_name as delayName, m.region_id as delayId, m.robot_name as robotName, a.warn_type as warnType, 2 as warnLevel, null as cameraName from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn a INNER join (select n.warn_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct d.device_mete_id) as device_mete_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct e.custom_id) as custom_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct e.device_id) as device_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct d.mete_name) as device_mete_name, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct e.custom_name) as custom_name, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct e.device_name) as device_name, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct e.device_type) as device_type, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct k.dict_note) as device_type_name, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct f.region_name) as region_name, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct f.region_id) as region_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct h.robot_name) as robot_name from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn_inspection n left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = n.inspection_id left join t_std_devicemete d on d.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id left join t_std_device e on e.custom_id = b.custom_id and e.device_id = b.device_id left join t_std_region f on e.up_region_id = f.region_id left join t_robot_inspection g on g.inspection_id = b.cruise_id left join t_robot_info h on h.robot_id = g.robot_id left join t_dict_business k on k.dict_code = e.device_type GROUP BY n.warn_id) m on m.warn_id = a.warn_id where 1=1 and a.warn_id = #{warnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select a.warn_id as warnId, a.task_id as taskId, a.inspection_id as instanceId from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn_inspection a where a.warn_id = #{warnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
